response.note: Interpreted 'recently' as the last 7 days (Oct 25-31, 2026) versus the prior 7 days (Oct 18-24), comparing attempt-level success rates assuming status value 'SUCCESS' denotes a successful attempt.
response.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-25' THEN 'recent_last_7d' ELSE 'prior_7d' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50
